newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Balongan refinery expected to restart late March.
newsitem.headline: Balongan refinery expected to restart late March.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned oil company Pertamina was facing bigger problems than anticipated at the Balongan refinery and was not expected to restart the units until late March, sources close to the refinery said on Tuesday.
Pertamina on February 6 closed the 83,000-barrels-per-day (bpd) long residue catalytic cracker (LRCC) following unexpected mechanical problems.
Attempts to restart the unit on February 13 failed.
Sources said the problem at the cracker was worse than originally expected and as a result the entire refinery was closed for major repairs.
Pertamina closed the 125,000-bpd crude distillation unit (CDU) this week, the source said.
